title: I Have Called You by Name
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler who steps in when his stomach flips, and tonight is about courage that comes from a voice you trust: Isaiah's people hear Fear not, I have called thee by thy name before the waters and the fire, and Beau lets go of the pool wall when his mom says his name.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because walking into deep water takes courage, and courage means knowing Someone is with you. In Beau's world today: the swim teacher asks him to step off the pool stair. His stomach flips over. He looks up, finds his mom's eyes, hears her say his name, and lets go of the wall. Just like the people who heard Fear not, I have called you by name, Beau learned that a loving voice is braver than the wall.
